name: JA_CN_VAT_HEADERS_ALL
description: This table contains VAT invoice header information.

columns.name: VAT_TRX_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Surrogate key that identifies a row in this table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Vat invoices for China invoice number.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: GTA_TRX_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Golden Tax transaction header identifier.

columns.name: GTA_TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of a Golden Tax transaction.

columns.name: FP_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: First party tax registration number.

columns.name: TP_TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Third party tax registration number.

columns.name: INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: VAT invoices for China invoice date.

columns.name: INVOICE_NET_AMOUNT
columns.description: VAT invoices for China net amount.

columns.name: INVOICE_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: VAT invoices for China tax amount.

columns.name: INVOICE_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup code for VAT invoice type. SPECIAL indicates a Special Invoice Type. COMMON indicates a Common Invoice Type. ALL indicates both Common and Special Invoice Types.

columns.name: INVOICE_CODE
columns.description: VAT invoices for China invoice code.

columns.name: TAX_RATE
columns.description: Tax rate for a VAT invoices for China tax.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Indicates description of a VAT invoice.

columns.name: ISSUER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the issuer of a VAT invoice.

columns.name: REVIEWER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the reviewer of a VAT invoice.

columns.name: PAYEE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payee of a VAT invoice.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer on a VAT invoice.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_PHONE
columns.description: Address and telephone number of a customer.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_NUMBER
columns.description: Customer bank account name and number on a VAT invoice.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of a VAT invoice. The statuses are COMPLETED and CANCELED.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
